name: support-triage
description: Route B2B SaaS support messages: intent, urgency, churn risk.

criteria.refund: money back, a reversed or duplicate charge
criteria.technical_help: a bug, outage, error or integration problem
criteria.billing_question: a question about an invoice, plan, price or payment method
criteria.information: general product, security or how-to information
criteria.cancellation: wants to cancel, downgrade or not renew
criteria.account_access: login, SSO, password, permissions or locked account

criteria: blocking work or a hard deadline
urgency.label: urgency

churn_risk.instructions: Does the customer signal they may cancel or leave for a competitor?
churn_risk.label: churn_risk
